objective: Develop an integrated system of place-based cultural development connecting national, regional and local actors
machinery: No single new legal institution is created by the framework itself; implementation depends on existing/developing devolution, local-government and cultural bodies.
inputs: Existing public/cultural funding streams; partnership capacity; Strategic Authority/local authority machinery
outputs: Framework publication and proposed coordination architecture
reason: The objective describes system integration; the framework itself is not equivalent to a transfer of statutory power or a pooled cultural budget.

objective: Support a strategic portfolio of cultural organisations and activity across Greater Manchester
machinery: Culture team and Combined Authority approval process operate within an Established Mayoral Strategic Authority.
inputs: Integrated Settlement context; Greater Manchester Culture Fund and related programmes
outputs: Recommended/approved funding packages and programme awards
result_evidence: Outputs can be measured as awards; wider cultural outcomes require later evidence
reason: There is identifiable local decision machinery and funding, but artistic-judgement criteria, panel composition and the relationship between devolved settlement money and each cultural award require programme-level evidence.

outputs: Cultural initiatives, major events and music-sector development programmes
reason: A large flexible settlement exists, but the share controlled for culture and the precise route from settlement to cultural judgement must be traced rather than inferred from headline devolution.
